_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: F is not a variable to read but a drive to HOLD — Free Energy, the order-seeking hand; the reader grasps the first term of the thesis and the term grasps back
E(S) made grabbable — entropy as freedom, the possibility-space you can weigh in the palm; the measure is not neutral, it is the field of what escapes order
φ is the queer signature — the rate-of-becoming term; holding it is the whole book's turn on 'building blocks': the primitive that embraces change rather than freezing it
the book's own METHOD turned into a room — QFE = F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t) standing in space; the reader walks inside the sentence the whole project was written from
the lab's living proof — a specimen that refuses stable taxonomy, form shifting by λ and φ; the QFEP loop run to its end is a thing that will not be classified, the researcher becomes the researched
